rv.q: THE WHO'S TOMMY The Musical's timeless themes of love, alienation, and the perils of hero-worship, along with its hit songs, exciting choreography, and marvelous performances, make this rockin’ revival one worth experiencing.
If you consider yourself a Wholigan, “The Who's TOMMY” might scratch a nostalgic itch.

cn.t: This multimedia rock opera spectacle delivers flashy visuals and energetic performances that thrill die-hard Who fans, though critics are split on whether the show connects beyond its nostalgic appeal to devoted Wholigans.
